 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Dallas Cowboys Add CB Help Amid Joey Porter Jr. Uncertainty For 49ers Game – Sports Illustrated, Josh Sanchez 
 Lacking healthy bodies in the secondary, the Cowboys have added some help just in case Joey Porter Jr. is unavailable versus San Francisco.
 With the status of star cornerback Joey Porter Jr. up in the air, the Cowboys elevated cornerback Derion Kendrick from the practice squad. Porter has been battling a nagging foot injury , which kept him sidelined in Week 9, but there is some hope he will be ready to go.
 5 free agents Cowboys should re-sign, and 5 notable names they should let walk – Levi Dombro, The Landy Hat 
 With the Cowboys facing some big decisions this offseason, here's a guess at who should stay and who should go.
 5 notable players in contract years that Dallas should let walk in March
 1. DeMarvion Overshown
 Overshown simply cannot stay healthy , to the point that it would be crazy for Dallas to sign him to any kind of lucrative deal. On a cheap contract, the Cowboys could justify it, but there would need to be very low guarantees and high incentives. As talented as Overshown is, he hasn't been available.
 Jerry Jones Rejects DeMarvion Overshown's Penalty Excuse – Dallin Ballard, Yahoo Sports 
 There was no excuse for DeMarvion Overshown's penalty and the Cowboys owner agrees.
 Jerry Jones is not buying the story that DeMarvion Overshown did not know the rules. The Cowboys owner dismissed the linebacker's excuse for running onto the field in street clothes during the win over the Indianapolis Colts. Jones told 105.3 The Fan that he thinks the veteran player knew exactly what he was doing.

 49ers downgrade a pair of defenders to OUT vs. Cowboys – Mike Masala, Niners Wire 
 In addition to being without Mike Evans, the 49ers are down some key players on defense officially.
 Now, on Saturday, the 49ers have downgraded cornerback Nate Hobbs and defensive lineman C.J. West to out. Hobbs, 27, joined the 49ers this offseason after four years with the Las Vegas Raiders and one with the Green Bay Packers . While San Francisco brought him in to compete for a starting job, he's been on injured reserve all year due to a groin injury.
 'We Like Our Football Team': Stephen Jones Explains Why Cowboys Stood Pat At NFL Trade Deadline – Grant Asfeth, Dallas Sports Journal 
 Cowboys COO clarifies why the Cowboys didn't make any upgrades at the trade deadline.
 A later deadline, falling after Sunday's game against San Francisco, would not have changed the approach, Jones said. "I think if we seen the right situation for us that we felt like would have improved our team, made sense for today and the future, then we certainly would have looked at it this last week," Jones said. "We wouldn't have been opposed to it, but at the same time, we never saw anything that made any sense." One of the hosts cited reports that no team called Dallas about trading wide receiver George Pickens , who is playing on the franchise tag. Jones said that did not surprise him.
 Cowboys vs 49ers: 2 players to buy, 2 to sell against San Francisco – Jorge Guajardo, Blogging the Boys 
 Players who could help and hurt the Cowboys on gameday.
 Buy: CeeDee Lamb
 I mean, who else would this list start with? Lamb has been the best player for the Cowboys all season, and there's no reason to think that Dallas will stop feeding him the ball. Lamb is coming off a monster performance against Indianapolis, hauling in 10 catches for 195 yards and a touchdown on 16 targets. It was his second-highest receiving total in a game during his career.
